name: WESR-Bench
description:
WESR-Bench
	

WESR-Bench is an expert-annotated natural speech dataset with word-level non-verbal vocal events, featuring both discrete events (standalone, denoted as [tag]) and continuous events (mixed with speech, denoted as <tag>...</tag>). 

	
		
		Supported Tags
	

Discrete events (15):

inhale, cough, laughs, laughing, crowd_laughter, chuckle, shout, sobbing, cry, giggle,exhale, sigh, clear_throat, roar, scream, breathing

Continuous events (6):

crying, laughing, panting… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/yfish/WESR-Bench.
reputation: Released on Hugging Face and of interest for research on non-verbal vocal events, but currently niche with limited broad adoption.
